en: All characters within a |BURST 2| area are knocked back |2 SPACES| and must pass a |HULL| save or be knocked |PRONE|
Throw a Concussion Grenade within |RANGE 5|. All characters within a |BLAST 2| area must pass a |HULL| save or be pushed |2 SPACES| away from the center on failure or |1 SPACE| on a success

All characters within a |BURST 1| area must pass an |ENGINEERING| save. On failture they take |4 HEAT| and are |JAMMED| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take |2 HEAT| and they are not |JAMMED|

Throw a Shock Grenade within |RANGE 5|. All characters within a |BLAST 1| area must pass an |ENGINEERING| save. On failture they take |2 HEAT| and are |IMPAIRED| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they are not |IMPAIRED|
